descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT OAT-06 test 5; UAT TC-17 step 4 · “Complete an encounter → both timestamps fire”. Mixed: stated part — Each completion path fires note_marked_complete and Cancel completes nothing; our part — Pending tasks removed by 'Delete Pending Tasks & Complete' logged as task_deleted (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Decision D13 · S2 · Daniela

Q5 / Q6: should 'Delete Pending Tasks & Complete' exist (TFA-92595 AC 8 asks for it; TFA-94700 AC 5 / UAT TC-24 allow no bulk delete), and if so, should each removed task write task_deleted? Today it writes none, so tasksDeleted undercounts (OAT-06/S26)

Other cases of the same question (counted once): TC-24/S29

Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S26 Mark Encounter Complete with pending tasks: Delete Pending Tasks & Complete / Keep Tasks & Mark Complete / Cancel — go back -> which rows (Hospital)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 Completing an encounter fires both timestamps (Pre-Round summary opened, note marked complete), and they aggregate per physician per day (UAT OAT-06 Test 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-94514 AC 4)
  • U8 Completing a task and deleting a task are logged as separate events; task reminders are tracked live (completed vs deleted logged separately) (UAT OAT-06 Test 7; UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 1; UAT TC-24; TFA-94514 AC 2)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Fresh physician with three note-ready Hospital charts, each with two open tasks (one fresh chart per row); T0 and the day's hospital rollup read at T0. Nursing Home has no pending-task choice: Mark Visit Complete completes at once (snf PostRoundTab.tsx:45-51), so this table is Hospital-only

When D1 chart 1: Mark Encounter Complete -> Delete Pending Tasks & Complete. D2 chart 2: Mark Encounter Complete -> Keep Tasks & Mark Complete. D3 chart 3: Mark Encounter Complete -> Cancel — go back

Then D1: note_marked_complete 1 and task_deleted 2 against chart 1. D2: note_marked_complete 1 and no task row. D3: no note_marked_complete, chart 3 still note-ready, rollup notesCompleted not moved by it. Rollup: notesCompleted +2, tasksDeleted +2

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT TC-17 step 4 (all three choices) + OAT-06 Test 5/7 + TFA-94514 AC 2 ('task deleted' logged) / AC 4. D1 is judged against AC 2: code read predicts no task_deleted row (PostRoundTab.tsx:453-457 drops the pending tasks through markComplete without logTaskTap); whether the bulk delete should count as deletions is in Q6. D3 judged: Cancel logs nothing and changes nothing. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S26 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows; to be decided by Daniela.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.
